MettleRNASeq MSc bone example

Files: mestrado_bone_expression.csv and mestrado_bone_metadata.csv
Dimensions: 8 samples, 235 genes; FLASH and STANDARD, 4 replicates each.
Species: Mus musculus. Tissue: bone.
Public source accession: GSE173944.
Original study: Velalopoulou et al. (2021), Cancer Research,
doi:10.1158/0008-5472.CAN-21-1500.
MettleRNASeq methodological context: bioRxiv doi:10.1101/2025.05.06.652387.

This is the processed B4.csv matrix supplied with Samella Salles' MSc project.
The original values are normalized and the genes are already preselected.
They are NOT raw integer counts and do not represent the complete transcriptome.
Only the table layout was changed: genes were aligned by ID and expression
was reshaped into samples in rows and genes in columns. No values were rescaled,
rounded, filtered, or recomputed during this conversion.
F1B-F4B correspond to FLASH and S1B-S4B to STANDARD. B denotes bone.

Original B4.csv SHA256:
32881b881120da6563118ec149467d07f2bc14b4b44baa3f20761bac57039482
Reshaped expression CSV SHA256:
9a5a42be35ab188fc6f1aad961f8a5237f46a575a5380b76c9987f3de78cd3ff

Use this subset to learn the software. Do not normalize it again, estimate
genome-wide differential expression from it, or treat the quick example as
a reproduction of the complete published biological analysis.
For a complete reanalysis start from the original count matrices and metadata.
Attribution to the original study and to the MettleRNASeq processing should
accompany reuse of this example. Confirm redistribution terms before a release.
